title: RAMP: Rethinking Multimodal Evaluation through Answer Readout Protocols
abstract: arXiv:2611.20653v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are often evaluated by converting model outputs into discrete answers. The conversion protocol determines which scores become predictions and can strongly influence the reported results. We introduce RAMP (Readout Aware Multimodal Protocol), a systematic framework that compares direct yes/no token logits, surface-form scores, and typed or reversed A/B interfaces under fixed model checkpoints and paired visual questions. On 500 POPE adversarial questions, typed versus bare readout changes accuracy by $-20.2$ percentage points for SmolVLM-256M, $-16.4$ for TinyLLaVA-1.1B, and $+1.8$ for Qwen2.5-VL-3B. Paired transitions reveal extensive prediction changes even when the net accuracy difference is small: 79 of 104 binary ChartQA items change correctness for SmolVLM-500M, despite a $+1.0$-point net difference. translated_title: RAMP：通过答案读取协议重新思考多模态评估
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）通常通过将模型输出转换为离散答案来进行评估。这种转换协议决定了哪些分数成为预测结果，并可能对报告的结果产生强烈影响。我们提出了RAMP（读取感知多模态协议，Readout Aware Multimodal Protocol），这是一个系统性框架，在固定的模型检查点和配对的视觉问题条件下，比较直接的yes/no token logits、表面形式分数，以及带类型标注或反转的A/B选项接口。在500个POPE对抗性问题上，带类型标注与裸读取方式相比，使SmolVLM-256M的准确率变化了-20.2个百分点，TinyLLaVA-1.1B变化了-16.4个百分点，Qwen2.5-VL-3B变化了+1.8个百分点。配对转换分析显示，即使净准确率差异很小，个体预测也会发生大量变化：对于SmolVLM-500M，104个二元ChartQA题目中有79个的正确性发生了改变，而净差异仅为+1.0个百分点。我们进一步分析了提示措辞、候选形式、选项位置、跨任务效应等因素（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出RAMP系统性评估框架，揭示了多模态大语言模型评测中答案读取协议的选择会强烈影响结果——不同读取方式可使模型准确率变化超过20个百分点，且即使净准确率差异很小，大量个体预测的正确性仍会发生改变。
en_tdlr: RAMP is a systematic framework demonstrating that answer readout protocols strongly influence multimodal LLM evaluation—readout choices can shift accuracy by over 20 percentage points and flip many individual predictions even when net accuracy differences appear small.
